context_requirements: Intact glutathione synthesis and cysteine availability to buffer thiol oxidation
Functional KEAP1-NRF2 axis for antioxidant response induction
Iron/heme availability for HMOX1 induction and ALAD inhibition
Active proliferation to reveal cytostatic consequences
TP53 pathway for DNA damage and apoptosis responses
falsifiers: No induction of NRF2 target genes (HMOX1, TXNRD1, GCLM, SQSTM1) at 6 h in any line
No decrease in ALAD or glutathione-related transcripts
Absence of oxidative stress signature at 24 h
No growth inhibition or apoptosis in responsive lines
Uniform lack of response across all nine lines

evidence.supports: Thiol-oxidizing agent diethyl maleate modulates redox-sensitive adhesion molecule expression
Oxidizing agent KBrO3 alters gene expression and chromatin structure with early and late responses
Sodium iodate oxidizing agent induces oxidative stress and modulates OS, inflammation, cell cycle, autophagy genes
Potassium dichromate oxidizing agent causes dose-dependent oxidative stress and gene expression changes
H2O2 oxidizing agent induces ER stress and NRF2-related antioxidant responses
